_about: Candidates B and C of the small crude tower (P4, decision D4), trays numbered as the player reads them (condenser 1, sump = tray_count). A is built in SmallColumn.candidateA from medium_crude.json / 64. Top pressure, condenser temperature, reflux ratio and design feed are A's. Steam keeps A's 0.0614 kg per kg of bottoms on A's residue plus its gas oil (5459 + 589 kg/h), 371.5 kg/h. Pumparound heat is A's 0.740 MW regrouped.

B.note: 20 trays: naphtha overhead, kerosene draw 6 and diesel draw 11 at A's rates, PA 10 to 8 between the draws (A's PA 1 + PA 2), PA 13 to 12 under the diesel draw (A's PA 3), feed 16, 3 stripping trays, sump steam

C.note: 14 trays: naphtha overhead, one middle draw 6 (A's kerosene + diesel rates), PA 9 to 7 under it (A's three PAs), feed 11, 2 stripping trays, sump steam

C1.note: C, variation 1: the pumparound moved to draw from tray 7 and return on tray 5, above the middle draw (C left the draw tray 10 % short of liquid: 15.54 asked of 14.07 kmol/h)
